job.job_description:
Role & responsibilities



5-9 years of professional experience in a relevant field.
Proven experience designing and developing production-grade Agentic AI and Generative AI solutions using frameworks such as LangChain and LangGraph.
Strong understanding of agent-based architecture, orchestration, inter-agent communication (A2A protocol), and integration with the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
Experience with evaluation frameworks (e.g., DeepEval, RAGAS) and evaluation pipeline testing, coupled with strong observability and traceability practices.
Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102) certification is mandatory.
Strong understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Small Language Models (SLMs), with solid hands-on experience in prompt engineering, Natural Language Processing (NLP), and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
Experience with specification-driven and evaluation-driven development practices.
Experience integrating applications with cloud services, the Microsoft Graph API, and other third-party services, as well as deploying solutions across various platforms.
Understanding of large-scale enterprise application architecture, along with appropriate design patterns and industry best practices.
Well-versed in Agile methodologies, with working experience using Azure DevOps, Jira, or equivalent platforms.
Proficient in programming languages such as Python, TypeScript, or C#.



Preferred candidate profile



Foundational understanding of Machine Learning and Deep Learning concepts.
Hands-on experience with Azure AI Foundry and frameworks such as Microsoft Agent Framework/AutoGen, along with other Azure AI services.
Industry-recognized AI certifications from providers such as Microsoft Azure and Anthropic.
